title: Tonight, Earth stops spinning

scenes.text: Right now, the ground at the equator moves about a thousand miles an hour.
Now it stops. But the air and the oceans don't.
Winds could tear across the surface at hundreds of miles an hour.
Oceans would surge inland. A wall of water, hitting the coasts.
Loose objects, even buildings, could be hurled forward.
But here's the twist. One day would now last a whole year.
Six months of blazing sunlight on one side.
Six months of freezing darkness on the other.
The good news? Nothing we know of could stop Earth this fast.
Comment what we should break next.

yt_description:
What if the Earth suddenly stopped spinning? Violent winds, flooding oceans, and a day that lasts a whole year.

Footage: NASA
